entry.name: Microsoft Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)
entry.note: Retired by Microsoft. The certification page states that this certification and its renewal assessment are retired
entry.audience: Engineers building on Azure AI services

covers: Integration of AI capabilities into applications
REST APIs and SDKs for image, video, NLP, knowledge mining, generative AI
Azure AI portfolio components and data storage options
reading.format: Proctored exam with interactive components, 100 minutes.
reading.status: This certification and the renewal assessment are retired.
reading.summary: This certification validates skills in designing and implementing Azure AI solutions using Azure AI services, Azure AI Search, and Azure OpenAI. It covers building, managing, and deploying AI solutions that leverage Azure AI. Candidates work with architects, data scientists, data engineers, IoT specialists, and developers to build secure end-to-end AI solutions and integrate AI capabilities into other applications.
reading.audience: For Azure AI engineers who build, manage, and deploy AI solutions using Azure AI. Candidates should have experience developing solutions with REST APIs and SDKs for image processing, video processing, natural language processing, knowledge mining, and generative AI on Azure.
reading.prerequisites: Experience developing solutions using REST APIs and SDKs; understanding of Azure AI portfolio components and data storage options; ability to apply responsible AI principles.
